target.echo:
======================================== CLINIC SYSTEM - Installation Guide ========================================
SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS: - Windows 7 or higher - Java 8 or higher (https://java.com/download)
INSTALLATION STEPS: 1. Make sure Java is installed on your computer 2. Extract this entire folder to any location 3. Double-click "run.bat" to start the application
FIRST RUN: - On first run, the system will automatically create the database - This may take 10-30 seconds - Please be patient!
FOLDER STRUCTURE: - ClinicSystem.jar : Main application file - admin_data.sql : Admin database structure - students_data.sql : Student database structure - database/ : Created automatically (database files) - images/ : User profile pictures - run.bat : Application launcher
TROUBLESHOOTING: - If "run.bat" doesn't work, make sure Java is installed - If database initialization fails, check that SQL files are present - If images don't load, check the images/ folder permissions
SUPPORT: For technical support, contact your system administrator.
======================================== Version 1.0 ========================================

#!/bin/bash echo "========================================" echo "Starting Clinic System..." echo "========================================" echo ""
# Check if Java is installed if ! command -v java > /dev/null; then echo "ERROR: Java is not installed!" echo "" echo "Please install Java 8 or higher" read -p "Press Enter to exit..." exit 1 fi
# Run the application java -jar ClinicSystem.jar
# Check if application crashed if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "" echo "========================================" echo "Application closed with errors" echo "========================================" read -p "Press Enter to exit..." fi
